### about.html TITLE= Deendayal Upadhyaya State Institute of Rural Development
﻿
Deendayal Upadhyaya State Institute of Rural Development
Introduction
Home
/ About Us / Introduction
The primary objective of rural development programmes is three- fold viz mitigation of existing socio-economic disparities; facilitation of access to basic civic amenities and up gradation of infrastructural development, thereby achieving an over-all amelioration in the living conditions of the common man residing in Rural Area.
For the fulfillment of these very objectives Deen Dayal Upadhyay, State Institute of Rural Development, an Apex Institute of the State Government of U.P., is dedicated to the activities of training, research and consultancy for enhancing the effectiveness of the implementation of various rural developments programmes. The Institute functions under the guidance of the Management Council, headed by the Agriculture Production Commissioner.
The Institution in its present Avtaar came into being on 1st April, 1982. Previously there were 02 separate Institutions namely Extension Training Centre and Orientation Training Centre. The later was subsequently upgraded and christened as State Rural Development Training and Research Centre. The Institution was renamed as Deen dayal Upadhyay State Institute of Rural Development (DDU-SIRD) on 30 July, 1994.
The SIRD is situated off the national highway-24, i.e. Lucknow- Sitapur Road, at a distance of 22 Kms. from Lucknow, and 3 Kms. from Bakshi Ka Talab Railway Station on the road leading to Indaurabagh. The campus is located on sprawling verdant premises of 13.5 acres.
Institute located in the sylvan and tranquil surrounding, away from the din and bustle of the city, the institute is taking decisive strides on its mandated path. The beautiful ambience provided by the sylvan expanse of fields and vegetation has an incredibility calm and balmy effect on the human eyes and mind. The pristine beauty of the surrounding is lent further charm by the melody of the cuckoo and nightingale. The historical pond which was built by Shri Tripur Chandra bakhshi and from where the place derives its name, is a mere 3 kms from the institute. Another celebrated landmark, the famous and holy temple of Maa Chandrika Devi, situated on the banks of the beautiful river Gomti is at a distance of 10 kms &om the Institute.
The Institute is located amidst a rich network of institutions and organizations viz the Biotech Networking facility, Minor Irrigation Training Institue, Regional Institute of Rural Development, Community Health Centre, Block Development Office and Revenue Tehsil, all of which are situated within a radius of 02 Kms. The SIRD partners with a entire set of Institutions located in its vicinity for increasing the efficacy of its training programmes. The Institute's proximity to the rural areas bestows upon on its natural immense advantage of its providing ready exposure to the field conditions to its trainees.
Vision :
Ceaseless upgradation of human skills and appropriate attitudinal reorientation through induction level and in-service training in consonance with the imperatives of changing environment.
Mission :
To enable people centric equitable development. Recognizing that capacity building of Institutions and individuals is as critical for effective public service as water is for life, the institute strives to achieve comprehensive augmentation of basic skills of the human resource in various sectors at multiple layers of governance, including that of elected representatives of local Self Government.
